name: Ethan's Legacy IF 01: The New Model
source:
A new model has just been accepted in your company and you are the designated manager. You're pretty sure that you both have never met each other before, but.. Why does she feel so familiar?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/VengeanceXXX]Patreon[/url]]
